goal: Skip Include What You Use analysis on subtree sources during CI runs
Avoids generating suggestions that conflict with upstream code and are discarded
agreement: Support noting minimal CI speedup and cleaner log output (maflcko)
Support noting it avoids an IWYU crash on subtree sources (David-Uka)
